answer: A meadow monitoring service pays agents to measure nectar near a willow grove. Require a separate bond for each sensor report, held until a randomly selected inspector visits the plot. Signed readings must name the plot and time; duplicate claims earn nothing. If an audit proves fabrication, burn that report's bond. Creating more identities then multiplies capital at risk instead of creating free rewards. Set the bond above the maximum fraudulent payout, and keep inspectors independent of sensor owners.
